findings.title: order() mixin is off by one for legacy WebKit flexbox
findings.body: The mixin emits `-webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val`, but the legacy box ordinal-group property is 1-based (its default is 1), whereas the standard `order` property is 0-based. The legacy value therefore needs to be `$val + 1`. As written, calls such as `@include order(2)` on .extra-info-wrapper and `@include order(3)` on .d-header .panel produce inconsistent ordering between legacy -webkit-box browsers and browsers using the standard `order` property, and an eventual `order(0)` or `order(1)` would collide with the default group. Fix the legacy declaration to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val + 1` (and apply the same adjustment to -moz-box-ordinal-group).

findings.title: Converting .small-action to flexbox silently disables the action button's float:right
findings.body: Making .small-action a flex container (lines 264-265) makes its direct children flex items, and `float` has no effect on flex items. The nested `button` rule at lines 306-310 still relies on `float: right` to pin the small-action button to the right edge, but that declaration is now ignored and no flex replacement (e.g. `margin-left: auto` on the button) is provided. The button will instead sit immediately after .small-action-desc, changing the layout of small action posts. Add `margin-left: auto` (or equivalent flex positioning) to the button and remove the dead float.
